summary.description: High-level summary of all proposed changes

contextSummary.description: Summary of the context sources analyzed (what was discussed, decided, etc.)

existingId.description: Fabric DB ID of the existing item (for updates)

existingIdentifier.description: Fabric identifier like EPIC-001, FEAT-002, F-003 (for updates)

to.description: Priority: P0_CRITICAL, P1_HIGH, P2_MEDIUM, or P3_LOW
Size estimate: XS, S, M, L, or XL

parentEpicIdentifier.description: Identifier of the parent epic (e.g. EPIC-001) for features

parentFeatureIdentifier.description: Identifier of the parent feature (e.g. FEAT-001) for stories

parentEpicTitle.description: Title of the parent epic (used when creating new epics inline)

parentFeatureTitle.description: Title of the parent feature (used when creating new features inline)

reasoning.description: Why this change is proposed, referencing specific context

sourceContext.description: Which context source(s) informed this change (e.g. teams_messages, meeting_transcript, notion_page, or multiple)

sourceRef.description: Customer's own line id from the scope document (e.g. VIS-02). Not a PM-tool id.

labels.description: Labels to apply on create, e.g. ["phase:1", "area:VIS"]

sourceDependencyRaw.description: Raw dependency cell from the source table, e.g. P1–2

dependsOnRefs.description: Explicit prerequisite line ids named in the document, e.g. [INT-01, INT-02]

dependsOnPhases.description: Phase horizons this item depends on, e.g. ["1","2"]

sourceChangeKey.description: Stable idempotency key for this change: the context id and the sourceRef joined by a colon

deliveryTrack.description: Delivery track preset, when the source states one

visionSuggestions.description: Explore mode only: purpose / core actions / cycle inferred from the conversation

purpose.description: One sentence: what the product is for

coreActions.description: 2–5 verbs: the core actions a user takes

cycle.description: The repeating loop the product supports (e.g. plan → build → review)
